# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It adds variable fonts, color font palettes, and animated WebP encoding, reworks the singleton lifecycle, and refreshes bundled native dependencies. This is a breaking release, particularly around default-typeface resolution and Vulkan 1.1 requirements — check the changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped; value-equality removed** — The property now returns GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo instead of GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo, and that type no longer implements IEquatable or the == / != operators. Update declared types and replace equality comparisons with per-field checks.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose no longer has a setter** — The protected property is now get-only. Subclasses that set it must instead pass the value through the constructor path SkiaSharp exposes.
- **new SKFont() and SKPaint.Typeface default handling changed** — SKFont() now eagerly stores an empty typeface instead of resolving null lazily, so MeasureText on an unset font returns 0. SKPaint().Typeface now returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Detect "unset" with Typeface.IsEmpty instead of comparing to null; construct SKFont with an explicit typeface when you need real measurements. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735), [#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default are now never null** — FromFamilyName("missing") returns SKTypeface.Default on every platform (previously null on Android), and SKTypeface.Default is guaranteed non-null everywhere, including Android API 36+. For a strict "was it found" check use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily, which still returns null on no match. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737), [#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738), [#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws and is obsolete** — The overload previously truncated large offsets silently via an unchecked cast; it now performs a checked cast and throws OverflowException for out-of-range values, and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range, validated offset. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls SK_ABORT (terminating the process, not throwing) if the instance or MaxAPIVersion is below 1.1. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion; genuinely 1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures; delete the other assignments, as there is no replacement. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout changed (new Components field)** — A new Components field (backed by GRVkYcbcrComponents) was added, changing the struct's layout. Code that manually constructs or depends on the layout of this struct must account for the new field. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs promoted to compile errors** — Legacy paint text/font state-reading members and other pre-v4 obsolete APIs are now compile errors instead of warnings, and obsolete enum members were trimmed from the reference assembly. Migrate off the flagged members before updating. ([#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m148** — Rolls the bundled engine forward through milestones 132, 133, 147 and finally m148, merging multiple rounds of upstream chrome bug fixes along the way. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))
- **Native dependencies refreshed** — Updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.0, FreeType to 2.14.3, libpng to 1.6.58, libexpat/expat to 2.7.5/2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, and zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley. ([#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720))

## API Surface

- **Variable and color fonts** — Adds variable font support across SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, color font palette support, and a new HBColor struct for hb_color_t. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))
- **Animated WebP encoding and stream/surface helpers** — Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP, SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion, and SKSamplingOptions support on SKSurface.Draw / SKCanvas.DrawSurface. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772), [#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **API wrapper gaps and naming fixes** — Adds previously-missing API wrappers and corrects naming convention violations across the binding. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel access corrected** — GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride, and the generic GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y) overload no longer swaps Height for Width when computing the offset. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **Finalizer and platform fixes** — Fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when its SKPathBuilder is collected first, corrects the WinUI Projection DLL resolution for .NET 9 consumers, fixes Apple TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps), and stops SKGLView from failing to render after a MAUI TabBar tab switch. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084), [#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798), [#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **New native asset targets added** — Adds Linux Bionic native asset support and Tizen x64/arm64 native build support, broadening the platforms SkiaSharp ships prebuilt natives for. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **WASM build trimmed to modern Emscripten** — Drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions to simplify the WASM build matrix. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Updates HarfBuzzSharp to 14.2.0 with variable font support, the new HBColor struct for color-font palettes, and additional API wrapper and naming fixes.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 12, 2026)

The release candidate updated Skia to m148, reworked the singleton lifecycle, promoted legacy paint APIs to errors, fixed pixel-span stride/offset bugs, updated HarfBuzz and expat, and fixed the WinUI Projection DLL issue.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Preview 3 refreshed native dependencies (FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, zlib), added HBColor and missing API wrappers, and dropped pre-.NET 8 Emscripten WASM builds.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)

## Preview 2 (May 6, 2026)

Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), the SKPath finalizer fix, and Apple TFM corrections.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.1.1...v4.147.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Preview 1 opened the v4 line, bumping Skia to milestone 147 (from 132/133), adding variable and color font support, and adding Linux Bionic and Tizen native asset targets.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v3.119.4...v4.147.0-preview.1.1)
